name: Shinomiya Naoto
source:
The only boy of the Shinomiya family. Has a huge sister complex.

When he discovers the sisters' plot to enjoy a fun sex life before being forced to marry middle aged men for their grandfather he hopes to impregnate them all before the year is over so he never has to say goodbye to his beloved sisters.
